snippet.title: It's Fine - Out Now!
snippet.description:
It's Fine is out now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3936270/Its_Fine/

Join your boss/dog Joe to the last 24 hours of game dev crunch, and do whatever it takes to release the game on time.

Click and upgrade to get your numbers going up, engage with unique mechanics and challenges, find all the secrets, and release your game on time!
